strings.TNS_German_DEF: die Gebiet des Militärbefehlshabers in Transnistrien
strings.TNS_Administration_DEF: the Administration between the Dniester and Bug
strings.TNS_communist_party_long: Komunistychna Partiya (bil'shovykiv) Ukrayiny-Ukrayins'ka Robitnycho-Selyans'ka Chervona Armiya
strings.TNS_Tighina_Accords_desc: The compact responsible for the birth of the Transnistria Governorate is just one of the many ways Romania has become intertwined with German affairs. The hybrid administration is responsible for governing it is a mix of Romanians and Germans. While one would expect the share of work to be equal, truthfully, Romania is responsible for most of the governorate's general management while Germany uses the land for military bases, troops, and certain economic concessions.
strings.TNS_Smochinas_Agitation_desc: A nationalist tendency is rising, one that has found its voice in prominent public figure Nichita Smochină. An ethnic activist, he has come to represent the militant Romanian settlers in Transnistria who demand it to be formally annexed into Romania. Slowly and daily, the Moldovan's connections to the former USSR grow weaker as Romanianization policies begin to take hold, strengthening Smochina's position.
strings.TNS_Ethnic_Turbulence_desc: Divisions between the Romanian administration, the Black Sea Germans, and the Ukrainian population are visible to anyone who picks up a newspaper to learn of the latest insurgency. German communities are administered solely by Sonderkommando R, which looks after their defensive and economic affairs. Romanian authorities do the same for their own. Meanwhile, Ukrainians toil tirelessly and thanklessly, forced to look after themselves while all relevant authorities remain apathetic to their needs.
strings.TNS_Land_Of_Contradictions_desc: Transnistria is a place fraught with uncertainty, a land where everyone contradicts each other. The administration is laden with corruption as Reichsmarks fill the pockets of bureaucrats, with no solution in sight from the Romanian government. The feuds between the mayor of Odesa and the head of the Romanian garrison have become legendary. It is telling that the most notable example of German-Romanian cooperation here was the coup of a former governor who refused to accept Bucharest's authority.
strings.TNS_Unwanted_Land_tt: If the Pontic Steppe could speak, it would have nothing to say.
strings.TNS_WORLD.1.desc:
It seems that Ukrainian nationalists, who almost destroyed Romania's puppet state of Transnistria a few years ago, have now successfully killed the local military governor with explosives planted in his car.

Reports have already begun to emerge that local partisans have seized power on the border region near the Hetmanate - Mohyliv, formed a provisional government - the “Council” or “Rada” - and declared that they will fight until the Romanian administration is completely expelled from the region.

Romania, in turn,declared martial law in Transnistria, sent its troops to Odesa and other areas to weaken the rebels as much as possible.German forces are also participating in clearing the region of insurgents.
strings.TNS_WORLD.1.a: It seems that the start of military operations in Transnistria is inevitable
strings.TNS_WORLD.2.desc:
Unexpectedly for international observers, Ukrainian rebels won the Transnistrian Civil War. Despite military support from the Reich and Romania, the German military garrison in Odesa collapsed, as the last forces hostile to the Ukrainian population were cleared out of the city. It can now be said with certainty: “Odesa is Ukraian”.

The Kingdom of Romania may now face a protracted political crisis, while the Greater Germanic Reich has declared that it does not recognize the statehood of the so-called “Dniester and Bug Administration” and demands from the Ukrainian Hetmanate “respect the borders established at the end of World War II”.

Official Kyiv has refrained from commenting on the current situation and stated that “the population of the region has chosen a future in the Ukrainian Hetmanate, rather than oppression and political persecution in the Kingdom of Romania”.
strings.TNS_WORLD.2.a: Ukraine has regained control over all its ports in the Black Sea.
strings.TNS_WORLD.3.t: {get_newspaper_header}Victory of the German Garrison in the Transnistria
strings.TNS_WORLD.3.desc:
Official communiques from Bucharest have confirmed what most have suspected for a while after collapse of Transnistrian government as the Romanian government has announced its evacuation of the Transnistrian territory.International observers were not surprised by the reasons for this, as it was the result of a violent and uncontrolled uprising by the Ukrainian population in the region.

The future of the former governorate is that of further Reich control as Romania transfers its responsibilities to the German administration, ruled under the control of military man Siegfried Haß.Siegfried has already announced the start of “cleansing the region of disloyal elements by force of arms”, which in reality means the total end of Ukrainian ambitions to control the Odesa region.

Officially, Kyiv, under the guise of “helping to restore stability”, annexed a region that belonged entirely to the rebels at the start of the conflict. The Reich remains silent on this issue.
strings.TNS_WORLD.3.a: The Hetmanate got a Beating in Transnistria
